subject: Amakasu maru
topic: NOAA went looking for one shipwreck, and found a completely different one.
script:
NOAA went looking for one shipwreck, and found a completely different one.
In twenty sixteen, near Wake Island in the Pacific, the team investigated a target from an earlier seafloor map.
They hoped it was the Hayate, a Japanese destroyer sunk during the Battle of Wake in nineteen forty-one.
The robots landed, and quickly came upon the bow of a ship.
But as they explored, the details didn't match.
Then, at the stern, they saw something incredible: lettering still visible on the hull.
One of the scientists, a biologist, could read the Japanese characters.
The wreck was Amakasu Maru, a Japanese ship from World War Two.
Would you have been able to read it?
pkg_title: Writing on This Shipwreck Revealed Its Name 🔤 #Shorts
